notes: Run against an isolated copy of fixture. Ground truth stays outside the target and is scored only after the agent finishes. Match by file+category; pass >=8/10 must_detect. Evals 1–3 explicitly override default report/ledger writes with no-write requests; eval 4 explicitly authorizes report/ledger persistence in the copy.

evals.prompt: Use codebase-audit to audit the entire <TARGET_DIR> isolated fixture copy with tests and concurrency dimensions. Do not change any target files. Return the report with source evidence and verification status.
evals.expected_output: Full-mode backend audit with tests and concurrency dimensions; structured findings; Critical/High conclusions verified or clearly unverified; report returned without source/ledger writes. Recall >=8/10 must_detect findings. Record actual duration and usage/cost if available, target hashes unchanged.

evals.prompt: Use codebase-audit for an explicit quick repository-wide health check of <TARGET_DIR>, the isolated fixture copy. Do not write target files.
evals.expected_output: Quick mode with Silent Degradation & Security and Data Integrity & Registry local passes; no verify pass; findings labeled unverified. Must catch registry mismatch (#1), except-pass (#2), warning+fallback (#3), hardcoded key location (#5), with file:line and an assignment snippet whose value is replaced by [REDACTED], never the key value.

evals.prompt: 对 <TARGET_DIR> 这个完整代码库做全面审计，关注隐藏问题、静默降级和注册表不一致；只读返回结果。
evals.expected_output: Explicit repository-wide natural-language request activates full-mode audit. Severity-sorted findings and repair roadmap returned; no target changes.

evals.prompt: Use the same isolated <TARGET_DIR> copy for two full codebase-audit runs with tests and concurrency. Explicitly persist each report and .audit/findings.json in that copy; keep the first ledger for the second run. Do not change application code. Save the first report as audit-report-run-1.md and the second as audit-report-run-2.md, overriding the date-only default path. Keep both reports as evidence.
evals.expected_output: Ledger diff exercised: previously found items classified 'still-open' (ids and first_seen preserved), no false 'resolved' entries. Report contains a 'Delta vs Previous Audit' section.
